body:
Adds `closed_loop.py`: a white-box adversary that picks its lie rate each block from its own live trust weight under rolling minority-label trust (the open item from Follow-up 6). Includes tests, an experiment section, and a README write-up.

Key result (14 honest + 8 adversaries, 5 seeds): rolling trust cuts plain Brier 43-79% against static lie rates, but against feedback controllers it gives roughly 0-5%. The threshold controller lies 38% of the time and does 2.4x the damage of a static 50% liar. Absolute harm stays small (<= 1.4% of faulty steps accepted). Defenses (private or randomised trust, asymmetric recovery) are left open and listed in the README.

Tests: 69 passed.
